tested.changes: Uncommitted Mercury gravity and crust lens sources above this base; no bake was run.

subject: MESSENGER HgM008 gravity anomaly and crustal-thickness grids (NASA Mercury Trek) used by the Gravity and Crust lenses

DegreeStrength_Map_HgM008_4ppd.tif.origin: member of https://trek.nasa.gov/mercury/TrekWS/rest/cat/data/stream?uuid=ce1982c6-f270-4a5b-9234-97c24d956ea5 (archive 7,297,728 bytes); read for the documented resolution limits only

ggmes_100v08_sha.tab.origin: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/messenger/mess-h-rss_mla-5-sdp-v1/messrs_1001/data/shadr/ggmes_100v08_sha.tab; coefficients for the independent synthesis check

gravityAnomaly.areaBeyondDisplayRange: 0.138% of the surface is beyond +/-150 mGal (endpoint colours)

minimum.note: inside Rachmaninoff (Gazetteer centre 27.66 N, 57.37 E, 305 km)

crustalThickness.meanDifference: 0.60 km lower than the stated average; cause not established

degreeStrength.halfWavelength: pi x 2,440 km / degree: 105 km at degree 73, 124 km at 61.7, 508 km at 15.1, 703 km at 10.9

independentSynthesis.method: Fully normalized spherical-harmonic sum of the PDS HgM008 coefficients (GM 22031.863566 km3/s2, R 2440.0 km from the SHADR header) at 12 map cell centres, written without the Trek files or the production loader.

gravityAnomaly.formula: GM/R^2 * sum over degrees 2-90 of (l-1) * normalized harmonic, in mGal
gravityAnomaly.finding: The Trek grid is the free-air anomaly with degree 2 (flattening and tidal terms) included, evaluated on the 2,440 km reference sphere; cells are placed correctly in positive-east longitude.

gravityDisturbance.finding: Matches the disturbance product; the product is not used.

independentSynthesis.degree2Contribution: Removing degree 2 changes the anomaly by 18.2 mGal at 0 N 0 E and 18.6 mGal at the north pole.

sharedLoaderCheck.gravity: packages/bake/src/objects/raster/scientific-raster.ts loadScienceSurface accepted the native grid with the raster.json declaration; Caloris Planitia centre 117.72, Rachmaninoff -237.41, north pole -63.94, south pole -14.81 mGal.
sharedLoaderCheck.crust: Refused: 'Scientific source grid changed' because the file declares GDAL_NODATA 'nan' and the grid declaration cannot express NaN.

limits: These checks establish decoding, placement, units and the anomaly definition. They do not test the gravity solution or the crustal model, and no browser view was inspected.
